value.note: je passe, ils passent; source attests elle passe.
nous passons, vous passez.
je passais; the participle passant is attested.
je passerai.
que je passe.

evidence.notes: Fully regular 1st-group -er verb with doubled s in the stem; it takes avoir when transitive and être when intransitive, which does not affect the stems.

value.note: y -> i before a silent ending: je paie, ils paient; the variants je paye, ils payent are equally accepted (both given in source).
nous payons, vous payez (attested).
je payais (attested); the stem stays pay- throughout the imparfait.
je paierai; the variant je payerai is also accepted.
je paierais (variant je payerais).
que je paie (variant que je paye), que nous payions.

evidence.notes: 1st-group -ayer verb with two accepted spellings (paie/paye) in the singular and 3rd plural, and two future stems (paier-/payer-); both are documented rather than treated as conflicting.

value.note: -eindre verb: je peins, tu peins, il peint (attested).
d becomes gn before a vowel: nous peignons, vous peignez, ils peignent (attested).
je peignais; the participle peignant is attested.
je peindrai; conditional je peindrais.
que je peigne; the attested passé simple il peignit / ils peignirent uses the same stem.
Irregular past participle peint (attested).

evidence.notes: Irregular 3rd-group -eindre verb; the full present paradigm, participle peint/peignant and passé simple forms are attested, confirming pein-/peign-/peindr-/peint-.

value.note: je penche, ils penchent; also pronominal se pencher.
nous penchons, vous penchez.
je penchais.
je pencherai.
que je penche.

evidence.notes: Fully regular 1st-group -er verb; the pronominal se pencher uses the same stems.

value.note: je pense, ils pensent (penser à / penser de).
nous pensons, vous pensez (attested).
je pensais; the participle pensant is attested.
je penserai.
que je pense, que nous pensions (attested).

evidence.notes: Fully regular 1st-group -er verb; related_context attests the present, subjunctive and compound forms.
